statutes.title: Infringement of Registered Trade Marks
statutes.description: Using an identical or deceptively similar trade mark, signature red color script, wave logo, brand name, or get-up in relation to identical or similar goods (such as soft drinks, detergents, apparel) without authorization of the registered proprietor.
statutes.penalty: Injunction, damages, account of profits, and destruction of infringing packaging.

statutes.title: Penalties for Applying False Trade Marks and Trade Descriptions
statutes.description: Falsely applying a trade mark or trade description to goods, or manufacturing, selling, or stocking goods bearing counterfeit brand logos or packaging.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment for 6 months up to 3 years, and fine between Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 2,00,000.

statutes.title: Causing Death or Injury by Rash or Negligent Act (Medical Negligence)
statutes.description: Whoever causes the death or severe bodily harm of any person by doing any rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide (including surgical negligence, leaving sponges, scissors, or swabs inside a patient's body during surgery).
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment for a term which may extend to 5 years, and fine.

statutes.title: Deficiency in Medical Service & Medical Malpractice Complaint
statutes.description: Filing consumer complaints before the Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission for deficiency in medical treatment, surgical errors, hospital negligence, or medical malpractice.
statutes.penalty: Compensation for medical expenses, physical suffering, disability, and loss of income.

statutes.title: Violation of Privacy & Hidden Cameras
statutes.description: Intentionally capturing, publishing, or transmitting the image of a private area of any person without consent in changing rooms, trial rooms, or private spaces.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine up to Rs. 2 Lakhs, or both.

statutes.title: Data Theft & Downloading Unauthorized Database
statutes.description: Downloading, copying, or extracting any data, computer database, or confidential customer information from a computer or secure server without permission.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine up to Rs. 5 Lakhs, or both.

statutes.act_name: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023 & Dowry Prohibition Act 1961
statutes.title: Cruelty and Abuse by Husband or Relatives for Dowry
statutes.description: Subjecting a woman to physical or mental cruelty, assault, illegal confinement, or coercion to meet unlawful dowry demands.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or up to 7 years, and fine.

statutes.title: Return of Amount and Compensation for Delayed Possession
statutes.description: Failure of real estate promoter or developer to complete or give possession of housing apartment or plot in accordance with the agreement terms.
statutes.penalty: Return of full amount paid with interest and statutory compensation.

statutes.title: Right to Life, Emergency Medical Treatment & Privacy
statutes.description: Protection of life and personal liberty, including right to emergency medical care without advance fee payment, and right to privacy.
statutes.penalty: Writ remedies under Article 226 / Article 32 and constitutional damages.

statutes.title: Prohibition of Employment of Children in Hazardous Occupations
statutes.description: Employing children under 14 years of age in any occupation or process, including glass factories, chemical units, or hazardous industrial processes.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment for 6 months up to 2 years, or fine up to Rs. 50,000, or both.

statutes.title: Unlawful Data Sharing & Personal Data Breach
statutes.description: Processing, selling, or transferring digital personal data, biometric data, or health logs without valid consent or for unauthorized commercial purposes.
statutes.penalty: Financial penalty up to Rs. 250 Crores imposed by Data Protection Board.

statutes.title: Prohibition of Insider Trading
statutes.description: Trading in securities or shares while in possession of unpublished price sensitive information (UPSI) prior to public announcement.
statutes.penalty: Disqualification, disgorgement of profits, and fine up to Rs. 25 Crores.

statutes.title: Terrorist Act & Conspiracy to Disrupt Public Infrastructure
statutes.description: Committing or conspiring to commit acts threatening unity, integrity, or security of India by damaging transport, defense, or public infrastructure.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment from 5 years up to life imprisonment or death penalty.

statutes.act_name: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act 2013 & BNS Section 75
statutes.title: Sexual Harassment at Workplace
statutes.description: Unwelcome sexual advances, explicit remarks, or quid pro quo demands for physical favors at workplace.
statutes.penalty: Disciplinary action, dismissal, and imprisonment up to 3 years.

statutes.title: Determination of Lease & Tenant Eviction
statutes.description: Expiration of registered lease term and tenant's unlawful refusal to hand over possession of commercial or residential premises.
statutes.penalty: Eviction decree, mesne profits, and damages for unauthorized occupation.

statutes.title: Request for Obtaining Information from Public Authorities
statutes.description: Right of citizen to request information, cost sheets, project vouchers, and public records from government and municipal bodies.
statutes.penalty: Mandatory disclosure within 30 days and penalty on Public Information Officer.

statutes.title: Compensation for Loss or Damage Caused by Breach of Contract
statutes.description: Breach of contract to supply raw materials or goods due to price fluctuations or commercial refusal.
statutes.penalty: Liquidated damages, compensation for actual loss, and specific performance.

statutes.act_name: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act 1974
statutes.title: Prohibition on Polluting Water Bodies & Draining Toxic Waste
statutes.description: Knowingly permitting poisonous, noxious, or polluting chemical matter to enter streams, wells, or village drinking water ponds.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment for 1 year and 6 months up to 6 years, and fine.

statutes.act_name: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act 2019
statutes.title: Declaration of Instant Triple Talaq Void and Illegal
statutes.description: Pronouncing talaq-e-biddat or any instant irrevocable divorce in spoken, written, or electronic form (such as WhatsApp).
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine.

statutes.title: Competency to Contract & Minor Agreements Void Ab Initio
statutes.description: Agreements entered into by minors (under 18 years) are void ab initio and unenforceable at law.
statutes.penalty: Agreement declared void; restitution of benefits where equitable.

statutes.title: Infringement of Copyright & Musical Works
statutes.description: Reproducing, streaming, or broadcasting musical compositions, sound recordings, or creative works without license.
statutes.penalty: Injunction, damages, account of profits, and destruction of pirated media.

statutes.title: Defamation & Malicious False Allegations
statutes.description: Making or publishing false and defamatory imputations against any person or judicial officer intending to harm reputation.
statutes.penalty: Simple imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both.

statutes.title: Deficiency in Service, Unfair Trade Practice & Refusal of Refund
statutes.description: Faulty dry cleaning ruining clothes, airline flight delays without food/accommodation, plumber leaving leaking pipes, AC repair failure, electrician wall damage, refrigerator breakdown, or dealer refusing statutory refund/repair/replacement.
statutes.penalty: Refund of full service/product fee, compensation for damage/harassment, and punitive costs.

statutes.title: Cheating, Dishonest Inducement & Replacing Original Parts with Duplicates
statutes.description: Laptop service centers, mobile repair shops, or mechanics secretly replacing original RAM, engine parts, or components with cheap duplicate parts during repair.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.

statutes.title: Breach of Service Contract & Unskilled Workmanship
statutes.description: Failure of contractors, service providers, dry cleaners, repairmen, or vendors to perform promised work with reasonable skill, causing property loss or damage.
statutes.penalty: Damages for actual loss, repair cost reimbursement, and breach of contract compensation.
